body.en: Lena (Early Brahmi: lene) means 'cave'. Many early inscriptions follow a formula naming the donor and the cave and giving it to the Sangha, often 'of the four quarters, present and absent' (agata anagata catudisa sagasa). A drip-ledge was cut above the entrance to keep rainwater out, and the inscription was usually carved just below it.

sources: S. Paranavitana, Inscriptions of Ceylon, Vol. I (1970)
